Current operational/managerial control reported to CMS: CHAIM SCHER (since 02/19/2019); MARC N RAAD (since 06/01/2015); MARK SCHWARTZ (since 06/01/2015).
Cost year 2025: related party disclosed as "Autumn Lake Heathcare LLC" for Management Company, cost reported $231,334 (16/m12).
Cost year 2025: related party disclosed as "Ultimate Therapy LLC" for Therapy Company (ST, PT, OT), cost reported $720,701 (13/5a, 9a, 10a).
Missing data: cost year 2015 left out because the figures failed the site's checks (reasons under missing_data)

findings.statement: Cost year 2025: DSS's review changed 9 line(s) of the report, a net reduction of $795,063 in the costs DSS counts. Largest: Other Nurses Aides And Attendants (page 13 line B11d), removed $560,660; Dietitian (page 13 line B1), removed $70,126; Movable Equipment (page 22 line 7d), removed $57,981. Separately, the home itself removed $2,602,298 from the costs it claimed (for example bad debt, pharmacy or therapy that the daily rate does not cover). The data shows each change, not the reason.

limitations: Dollar figures are as filed, before DSS audit, and are not adjusted for inflation. Compare per-resident-day figures with the Connecticut median for the same year.
Every year's full detail, including years left out here and the reason, is in https://danbeem.xyz/api/v1/facilities/075263/financials.json.
Built only from public datasets published on danbeem.xyz. Absence of a record means it is not in these datasets, not that it did not happen.
Every finding is labeled confirmed_fact, calculated, possible_association or investigative_question. Possible associations are not evidence of ownership, control or a conflict of interest.

missing_data.reason: Cost year 2015 is left out of this report: its figures failed the site's checks (resident days vs beds outside the plausible range; direct care per resident day outside the plausible range; direct care share of expenses outside the plausible range; core figures (days, revenue or expenses) could not be read; payer days do not add up to the printed total). The filing is still listed in financials.json.

recommended_follow_up: Identify who "Autumn Lake Healthcare, LLC" is (paid $231,334 for management services in cost year 2025); it does not match a management company on file for this home.
Check daily staffing for the flagged quarters on the Daily vs. CT Minimums page, then ask the facility for posted daily staffing records.

definitions.wages_reported: Salaries and wages printed on the cost report for that department. Not total department spending.
definitions.total_department_cost: Wages + allocated fringe + non-salary costs for the department, as computed by the site's cost-report build.
definitions.direct_care: DSS rate-setting definition: nursing and aide salaries, related fringe (allocated), and nursing pool (agency) cost.
definitions.figures: As filed by the home before DSS audit. Not Medicaid-allowable costs.
definitions.data_quality: Per year: status validated (core figures present, payer days add up, nothing out of range), unvalidated (read, but printed totals did not fully reconcile: treat as provisional) or check_failed (core figures missing or implausible: not used in reports). unusable_fields lists figures in that year that should not be quoted, with the reason.
definitions.raw_food_per_resident_day: Raw food cost / resident days. Only shown when the home buys its own food; when a contractor supplies meals the raw-food line is not comparable.
